notify_transitions.label: Notify on state transitions
notify_transitions.description: Show bounded notifications when VoxType starts recording, transcribes, returns idle, or stops.

notify_failures.label: Notify on failures
notify_failures.description: Show an error notification when a requested action or the status listener fails.

enable_overrides.label: Enable advanced one-shot overrides
enable_overrides.description: Allow the detail panel to pass validated options to one recording without changing VoxType configuration.

gestures.description: The saved action is retained even when it is unavailable in the current VoxType state.

active_label.label: Active label
active_label.description: Recording duration is timed locally and may be approximate after a plugin reload.

show_override_name.label: Show active override in widget
show_override_name.description: Append the selected one-shot output, model, or profile while it is active.

state.stopped: VoxType daemon stopped. Manage it outside this plugin.
state.error: VoxType reported an error state without additional details.

errors.missing_voxtype: The voxtype executable is not available on PATH.
errors.daemon_stopped: The VoxType daemon is stopped; manage it outside this plugin.
errors.start_unavailable: Start is available only while VoxType is idle.
errors.stop_unavailable: Stop and transcribe is available only while recording or streaming.
errors.cancel_unavailable: Cancel is available only during recording, streaming, or transcription.
errors.toggle_unavailable: Toggle is unavailable in the current VoxType state.
errors.overrides_disabled: One-shot overrides are disabled in plugin settings.
errors.invalid_output: The requested one-shot output mode is invalid.
errors.invalid_file: File output requires a non-empty path without control characters.
errors.absolute_file: File output requires an absolute path or a path beginning with ~/.
errors.invalid_model: The model override contains unsupported characters or is too long.
errors.invalid_profile: The profile override must be the name of an existing VoxType profile and contain only letters, numbers, dot, underscore, or hyphen.
errors.invalid_tristate: A one-shot on/off/inherit value is invalid.
errors.action_timeout: The VoxType recording action timed out.
errors.action_exit: The VoxType recording action exited with code {code}.
errors.action_not_launched: Noctalia could not launch the VoxType recording action.
errors.action_pending: Another VoxType recording action is still pending.
errors.listener_not_started: Noctalia could not start the VoxType status listener.
errors.version_diagnostics: Could not read the VoxType version.
errors.variant_diagnostics: Could not read VoxType variant diagnostics.
errors.diagnostics_interrupted: Diagnostics were interrupted by a plugin reload; run them again.

widget.daemon_external: Daemon lifecycle is managed outside this plugin.

panel.external_ownership: This companion never starts, stops, restarts, updates, or configures the independently managed VoxType daemon.
panel.missing_voxtype: VoxType is not installed or is not on PATH. Install and manage it outside this plugin.
panel.listener_unavailable: The VoxType status listener is unavailable. Reload the plugin after checking the executable; the companion will not start or supervise the daemon.
panel.daemon_stopped: The VoxType daemon is not running. Check its existing user service outside this plugin; no lifecycle command will be run here.

overrides.title: Optional one-shot recording
overrides.disabled: Disabled by default. Enable advanced one-shot overrides in plugin settings to use supported per-recording options.
overrides.explanation: These selections apply only when Start is pressed here. They reference existing VoxType models/profiles and never edit config.toml.
overrides.file_exclusive: File is the exclusive output for this recording. The absolute path is validated and shell-quoted; no other output is backed up.
overrides.profile_placeholder: Reference only; profiles are never created or edited
overrides.clipboard_privacy: Clipboard and paste are one-shot VoxType output destinations only. VoxType Suite never reads, scrapes, archives, restores, or backs up clipboard or transcript content.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.not_collected: Variant diagnostics have not been collected.
diagnostics.copy_failed: Could not copy the diagnostic summary.
diagnostics.privacy: The copied summary contains status and build metadata only—never speech, transcript, audio, logs, or existing clipboard content.
